description: Economic post-processing parameters for comparing single-use packaging and reusable container schemes (mainland China data). Transport cost now uses FULL per-km cost (fuel + depreciation + labor + toll + maintenance + insurance) via the e1/e2_cost_yuan_per_km overrides; the fuel-consumption fields are retained for reference only and no longer drive the cost calc. See reference/cost/00_README.md for the full source dossier. Distances are interpreted as kilometers.

loss_rate_sensitivity.description: Sensitivity of break-even demand and reusable total cost to the reusable-container loss/damage rate. fixed_demand null means use the instance order count. Covers the 2%-10% range promised in the loss_rate source note.

scenarios.name: large_or_reinforced_package
scenarios.description: Large/reinforced packaging scenario. SF material table includes several large or anti-pressure cartons at 10-15 yuan.

sources.value_basis: Full mainland-China source dossier for every parameter below, with URLs, dates and quoted text. Start here.

SF Express packaging material table updated 2025-09-23 lists standard carton No. 4 at 4 yuan, with standard cartons No. 1-6 at 1-6 yuan; anti-pressure large carton at 15 yuan. Confirmed by two independent SF sources (PDF price list + official pkg-normal page).

Net disposal/externality cost raised from 0.1 to 0.3 yuan: corrugated scrap residual ~0.04-0.08 yuan (national waste board paper 1500-1940 yuan/t) minus incineration ~0.045 yuan (150-180 yuan/t) plus unrecovered plastic auxiliary externality ~0.05-0.15 yuan. Keeping 0.1 is the conservative lower bound.
Xinhua reported a ZTO reusable box unit price of 36.5 yuan; after 50 cycles, material cost is 0.73 yuan per use. 50-cycle design life matches GB/T 43283-2023 resin-class minimum.

Xinhua notes reusable boxes add manual operation, scanning and vehicle transport costs; no precise public per-cycle value exists, so baseline uses 0.8 yuan cleaning/sorting and 0.1 yuan tracking/scanning per cycle as operating assumptions (RFID tag 0.3-5 yuan amortized over cycles + scan labor).

A 50-cycle design life implies about 2% material replacement per cycle; Xinhua/People's Daily/State Post Bureau all describe loss and damage rates as qualitatively high but give no precise public percentage, so 3% is an operating assumption. Sensitivity analysis tests 1%-8% (see loss_rate_sensitivity).

Switched from fuel-only to FULL transport cost. Fuel is only ~30% of road-freight cost (CFLP road-freight 2021 survey: toll 32.1% / fuel 30.1% / driver 19.7% / depreciation 13.3%). Nankai GTC model measures trunk full cost at 6.29 yuan/km -> E1 baseline 6.5 yuan/km (medium truck, 6-7 range). Shangchebang TCO gives 4.2m light truck 2.22 yuan/km -> E2 baseline 2.2 yuan/km (2.0-2.5 range).

iCET 2021 commercial-vehicle report 2025-scenario projection: medium truck 18.6 L/100km, light truck 8.2 L/100km (2019 actuals 20.2 and 8.9 x 0.92). Consistent with GB 30510-2024 / GB 20997-2024 tightening. Retained for reference; no longer used in the cost calc since per-km overrides are set. Electric last-mile alternative: ~30 kWh/100km (light truck) / ~15 kWh/100km (micro-van).

NDRC 2026-06-18 adjustment cut diesel by 495 yuan/t; Fujian 0# diesel fell to about 7.60 yuan/L after two consecutive drops (was 8.46 on 2026-05-21). Oil prices reset every 10 working days, so use a rolling mean or 7.5-8.5 range for modeling. Retained for reference only (per-km overrides drive the cost calc).

NDRC and related departments' green express packaging policy targets reusable express packaging scale (700万 by 2022, 1000万 by 2025) and encourages reusable packaging pilots; GB/T 43283-2023 sets cycle-count minimums.
